_comment: NeoForge composites this model at runtime from an empty bucket and a tinted overlay of the
fluid (loader 'neoforge:fluid_container'), which is why the shared tree has no bucket texture
at all. Fabric has no equivalent model loader, so this is vanilla's water bucket.
FABRIC TODO: the liquid reads blue instead of experience green. The fix is a purpose-drawn
texture, or a two-layer model with an item colour provider tinting only the fluid layer --
tinting this single-layer sprite would take the metal with it.
